hooks.command: CHANGED=$(git status --porcelain 2>/dev/null | grep -v -E '\.DS_Store$|tsconfig\.tsbuildinfo$'); if [ -n "$CHANGED" ] && ! echo "$CHANGED" | grep -q "testflow-ai/docs/PROJECT_STATUS.md"; then printf '%s' '{"decision":"block","reason":"The repo has uncommitted changes but docs/PROJECT_STATUS.md was not updated (CLAUDE.md rule 22). Update it now \u2014 date, branch/commit, completed work, tests actually run and their results, deployment/demo link, blockers, next three tasks \u2014 then finish again. Never mark untested work as complete."}'; else printf '{}'; fi
